rules: PRODUCTION_SPEC §1/§3/§9; flat LIGHT backgrounds; product cut out; 1–3 words on screen; a detailed 2-D object in every shot; watermark below content; logo end card; audio LOCKED. Length 45–55 s, HARD CAP 58 s. Draw no COROS or Garmin logos (text names only). Never say/show 'first COROS watch with a flashlight' — only 'first VERTIX'.
official_clips: none (COROS page uses frame sequences, no MP4) — stills with motion only
palette_for_this_video: paper main; sky for the numbers; marigold for the flashlight beam / nits; blush for THE CATCH; mint for SPEC
new_objects: watchOutline (generic round unbranded watch: bezel ring, 4 buttons, strap stubs; `label` under it; `screen` text inside), lightBeam (cone of warm light from a point, 3 brightness steps `level` 1–3 with soft falloff; reuse later for torches/headlights/projectors), mountainSunrise (flat 3-peak ridge with sun rising behind, `t` 0–1 = dark→dawn) — add each to render/kit/OBJECTS.md. Reuse: sun (nits), calipers (thickness), battery or calendar (30 days), priceTag, bars, clockRing, calendar, questionStamp, scoreTable, pill, counter.

scenes.anchor: Coros just put a flashlight in its expedition watch!
scenes.image: A cut out centred 75% width, slight push-in
scenes.object: new lightBeam fires from the watch's right edge (level 3, marigold) across the frame; small new mountainSunrise silhouette at the bottom, dark
scenes.note: frame 1 = poster A: watch + beam + 'FLASHLIGHT' huge, readable instantly

scenes.object: questionStamp '?' slams beside the beam; beam flickers off/on once

scenes.image: E cut out (black) 70% centre, A slides in small right (two colours)
scenes.object: new watchOutline ghost behind E with label 'VERTIX 4'; pill '2 colours'

scenes.anchor: It's the first Vertix with a built-in light.
scenes.image: C (gloved hands, beam on) masked in a rounded card 85% width
scenes.object: lightBeam steps level 1→2→3 with tick marks '1 2 3'; small pill 'first VERTIX'

scenes.anchor: Get this. A one-point-four-seven inch screen, at thirty-five hundred nits.
scenes.object: ruler across the watch face labelled '1.47"'; sun with rays growing, counter rolls 0→3,500 'nits'
calipers close on the case and read '13.8 mm'; pill '−14% vs Vertix 2S'

scenes.anchor: with up to thirty days of battery.
scenes.image: D (wrist on mountain) masked card 80% width
scenes.object: calendar flips 1→30 while battery icon stays full; small footnote pill 'up to · always-on off'

scenes.anchor: Here's the catch. You'd pay eight hundred dollars, a hundred more than the Vertix two S.
scenes.object: two priceTags: '$699 · Vertix 2S' (grey) and '$799 · Vertix 4' (red) drop in; '+$100' arrow between them

scenes.anchor: GPS drops from one-eighteen to one-oh-five hours.
scenes.object: bars: 'Vertix 2S 118 h' vs 'Vertix 4 105 h' (shrinks), clockRing small; label 'standard GPS'

scenes.anchor: Satellite maps? Not until twenty twenty-seven.
scenes.object: calendar page lands on '2027' with pill 'satellite maps'; hourglass small

scenes.anchor: By our score? Fifty-five out of a hundred.
scenes.object: scoreTable bars fill: price 15/25, claim 12/20, new 8/15, lasts 7/15, catch 8/15, buy 5/10 → TOTAL 55

scenes.anchor: It's a spec. Just barely. Grab it if you climb before sunrise.
scenes.object: k snaps upright (SPEC end-card motion) but wobbles once ('just barely'); mountainSunrise t 0→1 behind; pill '✓ pre-dawn climbers'

scenes.anchor: Would you pay eight hundred for a flashlight watch?
scenes.object: scale tips between '$799' and lightBeam icon; ends on the frame-1 layout (beam on)
